targets.query: SELECT last($vars) AS $vars FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT
   LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_A") AS "201-B-01-Current", 
   LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_A") AS "202-B-01-Current", 
   LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_A") AS "202-B-03-Current", 
   LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_A") AS "202-B-04-Current",
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_A") AS "202-B-05-Current", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_A") AS "202-B-06-Current"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_DiffP") AS "201-B-01-DiffP", 
    LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_DiffP") AS "202-B-01-DiffP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_DiffP") AS "202-B-03-DiffP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_DiffP") AS "202-B-04-DiffP",
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_DiffP") AS "202-B-05-DiffP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_DiffP") AS "202-B-06-DiffP"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_InletP") AS "201-B-01-InletP", 
    LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_InletP") AS "202-B-01-InletP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_InletP") AS "202-B-03-InletP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_InletP") AS "202-B-04-InletP",
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_InletP") AS "202-B-05-InletP", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_InletP") AS "202-B-06-InletP"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_InletT") AS "201-B-01-InletT", 
    LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_InletT") AS "202-B-01-InletT", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_InletT") AS "202-B-03-InletT", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_InletT") AS "202-B-04-InletT",
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_InletT") AS "202-B-05-InletT", 
    LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_InletT") AS "202-B-06-InletT"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
        LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_MotorT") AS "201-B-01-MotorT", 
	LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_MotorT") AS "202-B-01-MotorT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_MotorT") AS "202-B-03-MotorT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_MotorT") AS "202-B-04-MotorT",
        LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_MotorT") AS "202-B-05-MotorT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_MotorT") AS "202-B-06-MotorT"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
        LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_OutletT") AS "201-B-01-OutletT", 
	LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_OutletT") AS "202-B-01-OutletT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_OutletT") AS "202-B-03-OutletT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_OutletT") AS "202-B-04-OutletT",
        LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_OutletT") AS "202-B-05-OutletT", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_OutletT") AS "202-B-06-OutletT"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
        LAST("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_VFDRPM") AS "201-B-01-VFDRPM", 
	LAST("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_VFDRPM") AS "202-B-01-VFDRPM", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_VFDRPM") AS "202-B-03-VFDRPM", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_VFDRPM") AS "202-B-04-VFDRPM",
        LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_VFDRPM") AS "202-B-05-VFDRPM", 
	LAST("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_VFDRPM") AS "202-B-06-VFDRPM"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_kW")   AS "201-B-01-kW",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_kW") AS "202-B-01-kW",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_kW")            AS "202-B-03-kW",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_kW")            AS "202-B-04-kW",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_kW")            AS "202-B-05-kW",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_kW")            AS "202-B-06-kW"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_VFDHz")   / 10 AS "201-B-01-Hz",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_VFDHz") / 10 AS "202-B-01-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-03-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-04-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-05-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-06-Hz"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Instruments-PIT20166") AS "201-B-01-PIT",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-PIT20267") AS "202-B-01-PIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20268") AS "202-B-03-PIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20269") AS "202-B-04-PIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20270") AS "202-B-05-PIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20271") AS "202-B-06-PIT"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Instruments-FIT20160") / 60 AS "201-B-01-FIT",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-FIT20261") / 60 AS "202-B-01-FIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20262") / 60 AS "202-B-03-FIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20263") / 60 AS "202-B-04-FIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20264") / 60 AS "202-B-05-FIT",
    last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20265") / 60 AS "202-B-06-FIT"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_InvInTemp") AS "201-B-01-InvInTemp",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_InvInTemp") AS "202-B-01-InvInTemp",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_InvInTemp") AS "202-B-03-InvInTemp",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_InvInTemp") AS "202-B-04-InvInTemp",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_InvInTemp") AS "202-B-05-InvInTemp",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_InvInTemp") AS "202-B-06-InvInTemp"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Instruments-FIT20160") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)",
    last("Pre_Aeration-Instruments-PIT20166") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

SELECT
    last("Pre_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20101_VFDHz")   / 10 AS "201-B-01-Hz",
    last("Anoxic_Aeration-Blower_Ctrl-B20201_VFDHz") / 10 AS "202-B-01-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20203_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-03-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20204_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-04-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20205_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-05-Hz",
    last("MBR-Blower_Ctrl-B20206_VFDHz")            / 10 AS "202-B-06-Hz"
FROM "mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT last("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-FIT20261") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)", last("Anoxic_Aeration-Instruments-PIT20267") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

SELECT last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20262") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)", last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20268") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

SELECT last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20263") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)", last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20269") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

SELECT LAST("MBR-Instruments-FIT20264") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)", LAST("MBR-Instruments-PIT20270") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

SELECT last("MBR-Instruments-FIT20265") / 60 AS "FlowRate (m3/min)", last("MBR-Instruments-PIT20271") / 60 AS "OutletPressure (mmAq)"
FROM "autogen"."mqtt_consumer"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)
